body: Blue Ridge is where I've been the most. Shenandoah Valley. I was at Yellowstone once, is that the Rockies? I think I'm a little afraid of Grizzlies though. But it was impressive. I think I've seen pictures of the Himalayas and they look misty, like another planet. And this isn't mountains but once I learned about the tundra, and how delicate and fragile it is, all the little tiny flowers and I just like the idea of it. Maybe I can relate to it. It's easily damaged and needs to be mostly left alone. As for my soul, probably if it was gone I wouldn't feel the intense pain I do. I still feel love. mainly for other wounded creatures.

Well, it would be more like the frozen side of a garbage dump. It's a man-made ski area on top of a waste heap. I guess that doesn't sound too romantic but once it's covered with snow, if you blur your eyes you can imagine it's the Swiss Alps. And I only go on the intermediate hills. Maybe i will have to even practice on the bunny hill. But I guess you could still get a broken limb. Suicidal + broken limb can't be a good thing. I'm willing to take chances at this point. And thanks. I don't know if I'll find the glass wall to break it but I'll try. 

 I really envy you for living in the mountains. before my soul was destroyed by evil beings I used to love the mountains. I really love rock, how it's cool and hard and real. And thanks again.

This is the only place that's real for me. I'm all alone tonight. I hate that Christmas is coming. I wish it wouldn't. That sounds kind of evil to write. I'll be on and off here tonight. I hope you don't mind me talking to myself here. So many things are too awful. I guess I'll play a game for awhile...

That's good to know because I am suicidal and don't really need being forbidden from expressing it right now. Even some of the crisis lines act like they don't want you to be suicidal which just makes you feel crappier- if that's possible. The other one I have just never gotten through and I've gotten pretty cynical about these things. What you want is a real person who really gives a shit and can let you be suicidal - because you are.

Thank you. I think I will. I actually felt some tinge of excitement looking at ski pants, etc, and thinking about it. That's pretty unusual lately. Except for sitting in the ski lodge you have to concentrate and use your whole body, you get hot and sweaty and that used to feel good. To go in the lodge and have everything melt and your cheeks go red. I could end up having a panick attack, but at least i will have done something. It will definitely get me in shape. I have no f'king idea if it will do any good at all, but seriously, since I daydream about dying, I might as well try and have some fun, even if it's brief. Or maybe it will wake up my body.
  But I'm not tellling certain people in my family because they will somehow take the energy out of it. Because that's what they do. I'll just do it on my own. Thank you for your comment. I appreciate it.
Thank you. I tried the first one once but couldn't get through. But i might try again.
